source.quote: 查看DC具体的rules和规则 这个context我们是需要检查的
source.review_document: /mnt/project-files/data-part/DC_规则和上下文检查_20261008.md (requests captured at runtime from the synthetic fixtures)
source.decision: Decision card '按检查稿第 5 节修改 DC 的规则和上下文吗？': 全部按建议 (label definitions start from the draft and remain open to user review).

findings.text: Table descriptor source_notes took whole sheet rows, so side-by-side tables leaked a neighbour's title and header into DR, DC-label and DC-review context.
findings.change: source_notes restricted to the table's own columns, except DOI-anchor layouts.

findings.text: DC-split received the coverage-scope paragraph and no statement that splitting ignores relevance.
findings.change: No DATA_SCOPE_INSTRUCTIONS for DC-split; relevance sentence added.
Each rule lists its calls: split DC002, DC007; label DC001-DC003, DC008; review DC001-DC006.

findings.text: Warning instructions let DC-review close any warning by a finding, contradicting the G008 ledger, and blocked coverage on warnings due later.
findings.change: In DC-review warnings close only through ledger_outcomes at their due step; the coverage block applies only to warnings due at or before the requirement.

findings.text: Label and column values had names but no definitions.
findings.change: label_vocabulary (draft definitions, pending user review) sent to DC-label and DC-review; host code checks it defines every value.

findings.text: DC-label pages after the first had no header, title or note cells to cite.
findings.change: Every page repeats those cells; body cells are read once.

findings.text: DC-review received host file bindings (paths, hashes).
findings.change: Review receives requirement and label content only.

rule_changes: dc_coverage.json 1.4.0: rules carry calls; label_vocabulary added.
verification: research_pipeline suite: 18 failed, 542 passed, 7 skipped, 2 errors; identical failure list to the pre-change baseline (environment: no R).
